title: BPBD Sumatera Barat 2015 local operational taxonomy compatibility gate
research_question: Can the separately published 2015 Pusdalops PB BPBD Sumatera Barat incident counts be used as an independent same-concept crosscheck for M42 BNPB/DIBI disaster-event and impact aggregates?

bpbd_sumbar_pusdalops_2015.title: Laporan Kegiatan Pusdalops PB BPBD Sumbar Tahun 2015
bpbd_sumbar_pusdalops_2015.producer: Pusdalops PB BPBD Provinsi Sumatera Barat
bpbd_sumbar_pusdalops_2015.evidence_table: Tabel 4.2. Tabel Jumlah Kejadian Perjenis Bencana tercatat selama Tahun 2015
bpbd_sumbar_pusdalops_2015.evidence_access_note: Official provincial-government PDF was discoverable and its indexed table text was reviewed; direct PDF retrieval was unavailable during the review session, so this milestone freezes a discovery/compatibility gate rather than a canonical source snapshot.

perka_bnpb_7_2012.title: Pedoman Pengelolaan Data dan Informasi Bencana Indonesia
perka_bnpb_7_2012.relevant_rule: DIBI province and district/city use the same DIBI application/data basis as DIBI National but may add locally needed data and disaster classifications; local implementations can also use finer administrative detail.
perka_bnpb_7_2012.evidentiary_role: Explains why a local BPBD operational taxonomy can legitimately be broader than the national DIBI aggregate and blocks an assumption of concept identity.

comparison.reason: The two totals are produced under unproven upstream independence and visibly different inclusion/classification scopes. Perka BNPB 7/2012 explicitly allows local DIBI implementations to add data and classifications.

claim_boundaries: The BPBD report is evidence that a broader local operational incident universe existed in 2015; it is not evidence that BNPB/DIBI omitted 597 otherwise-equivalent disaster events.

A separately published local report is not automatically an independent upstream source because provincial DIBI and national DIBI are institutionally related and can share data while allowing local additions.
No BPBD operational incident count is inserted into the canonical BNPB disaster panel.
No historical victim or damage metric is promoted from this source discovery.
M42 absent rows remain missing, not zero.

next_gate.title: BPBD local operational incident layer and historical impact-source discovery
tasks: Search 2014-2017 BPBD/Pusdalops reports for victim and physical-impact fields with explicit definitions and event/district provenance.
Keep a prospective BPBD operational-incident layer separate from the BNPB/DIBI disaster-event layer unless a taxonomy crosswalk is directly evidenced.
Document whether local Pusdalops records are direct contributors to DIBI for the reviewed years before calling any overlapping values independent.
Only reconcile victim/damage values when source independence, metric semantics, geography, and aggregation rules are all sufficiently qualified.
